compositionBoundary: Consumes one exact, live, single-use LeaderAuthorityK that binds the demand, inert integrated plan, target, before digest, and exact after digest. Only the stable Codex actor writes; supplier artifacts remain authority-free.
receipt: CandidatePatchK binds the plan, authority claim, exact before/after bytes, source-provider receipts, native resource receipt, and author process.
refusal: Refuse a plain Leader expression, authority reference, forged or stale content address, expired/replayed authority, changed preimage, scope/path escape, symlink, non-Codex actor, unintegrated plan, or missing native resource receipt before mutation.
acceptance: Candidate delivery is never verification, customer acceptance, demand closure, revenue, or proof that cost was incurred.
